question: Which two actions must be taken to directly connect a Fibre Channel storage array to a Cisco UCS domain? (Choose two.)
options: Configure a Fibre Channel port channel.
Configure the Fibre Channel port as a Fibre Channel storage port.
Create a new vHBA dedicated to the storage array.
theory: Directly connecting an FC storage array to a Cisco UCS domain (without an external SAN switch) requires configuring the fabric interconnect's FC port specifically with the Fibre Channel storage port role — not a generic FC uplink or port channel, which assume an upstream switching fabric — and configuring a new VSAN to logically carry that storage traffic, since a VSAN boundary is required for any FC/FCoE traffic on the fabric interconnect. A dedicated vHBA and a storage connection policy may also be involved in full end-to-end zoning, but the two foundational actions for the direct attachment itself are the storage port role and the VSAN. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 12 — Cisco UCS Storage Management, Direct-Attached FC Storage)
